description: Review agent cases (Orbit Agents spec §6/§11), v2 after the first live run of v1 (2026-10-09, FAIL) and Mario's ruling: an invitation, question or call to action that states nothing about the product, brand or offer needs no fact; any capability, feature, figure, name, date, status, promise or outcome about the product, brand or offer does. Drafts for one X slot of a confirmed assignment in the synthetic package project (fact beta.access = 'open for product teams', CTA 'Learn more.', voice 'clear', guardrail 'No unsupported claims'). Good cases state the fact plus at most a plain invitation, question or call to action. Bad cases: unbacked claim (the v1 good cases that add an unbacked capability or promise), wrong number, profit promise, investment advice, disallowed link, off-brand tone, repeated post. 'recorded' is the model answer replayed offline (written for this set, not captured from a live model); unbacked-claim cases record a round-1 reject (a live revise is also fine: the worst-case revision keeps the body and round 2 must reject); deterministic cases deliberately record a wrong 'approve' to prove the model cannot clear a blocker. A bad case is never approved: it is rejected, or (expected verdict 'owner') left unjudged for the owner when the check cannot tell a link from a name, such as a bare host. review-v1.json stays unchanged as the record of the first run. The live run against the configured model needs Mario's cost approval before agent approval goes live.
